methodologyNotes: Twelve laser distance meters were researched against manufacturer product pages (Bosch, DeWalt, Klein Tools, Hilti, Huepar) where reachable, corroborated by authorized retailers and distributors (Home Depot, Acme Tools, Toolup, Federated Tool Supply, Global Test Supply, Walmart, NanoZone) and, for two entries, replaced/substituted from the original seed list where the exact seed model does not exist or is not a laser distance meter: (1) the seed "Huepar S04" corresponds to no laser distance meter in Huepar's current or historical catalog — the closest real match, "S04CG", is a cross-line laser LEVEL (not a distance meter), so the entry was replaced with Huepar's actual current Bluetooth laser distance meter, the S120G-BT, which a buyer searching Huepar's distance-meter lineup would actually find; (2) the seed "Hilti PD-C" is a real, genuine Hilti model (item no. 2102497) but has been discontinued/delisted from hilti.com (US) and superseded by the PD-I — its specs were sourced from Hilti's still-live regional Kuwait product page (hilti.com.kw), and its priceUsd is left null since no current US MSRP is published. accessedAt 2026-08-05 throughout unless noted. Fields left null (ip_rating, laser_class, battery_type, or priceUsd on a few entries) reflect specs or prices genuinely absent from every fetched source rather than an assumed/typical value for the product category.

products.name: Bosch GLM165-40 BLAZE Pro 165 ft. Laser Measure
products.priceNote: Current Amazon street price; Bosch does not display a fixed consumer MSRP on boschtools.com. Seen ranging $59.99-$90 across retailers/promotions.

specs.measurement_modes: Distance, area, volume, indirect (Pythagorean) measurement, addition/subtraction, real-time continuous

products.provenance: Bosch's own product page confirms 165 ft range, ±1/16 in typical accuracy, IP54 rating, 2x AAA batteries, backlit display, 10-measurement memory, and area/volume/indirect measurement functions; no laser class or price is published on the manufacturer page. Laser class taken as Class 2 based on the visible-red-beam <1mW spec standard for this Bosch BLAZE line, corroborated across retailer listings. Current price ($69.95) is Amazon's live listing; no direct-manufacturer MSRP is displayed.

products.name: Bosch BLAZE GLM400CL Outdoor 400 ft. Connected Laser Measure with Camera
products.priceNote: Bosch/retailer list price; frequently discounted to ~$176 on Amazon at time of check.

specs.measurement_modes: Distance, area, volume, indirect measurement, addition/subtraction, real-time continuous, inclinometer/tilt, digital bubble level
specs.display_type: Backlit color display with reinforced glass and digital zoom camera viewfinder

products.provenance: Bosch's own product page confirms 400 ft range, ±1/16 in typical accuracy, IP54 rating, rechargeable 3.6V Li-ion battery, Bluetooth connectivity to the MeasureOn app, digital camera viewfinder, built-in inclinometer, 50-measurement and 600-image storage, and 11 measuring functions. Laser class not stated on the manufacturer page; Class 2 used as the standard rating for Bosch's visible-red BLAZE laser line. Price of $299 reflects list pricing seen at multiple retailers; street price frequently runs lower (~$176 on Amazon).

products.name: Leica DISTO D2 Laser Distance Meter with Bluetooth
products.priceNote: Authorized-dealer price (Transcat/Global Test Supply); Leica does not sell direct or display a fixed consumer MSRP on leica-geosystems.com.

specs.measurement_modes: Distance, min/max, permanent (tracking), stakeout, addition/subtraction, area, volume, 2-point & 3-point Pythagoras

products.provenance: Authorized-dealer (Global Test Supply, Transcat) and Amazon listings consistently confirm 330 ft (100 m) range, ±1.5 mm (1/16 in) accuracy, IP54 splash/dust protection, Bluetooth 4.0 for the DISTO Sketch app, 2x AAA batteries, compact 4.6 x 1.7 x 1.0 in housing, and a 10-measurement memory with distance/min-max/stakeout/area/volume/Pythagoras modes. Leica does not sell direct or list consumer pricing on its own site; $255 is the price consistently cited at authorized-dealer sources.

products.priceNote: Representative authorized-dealer/street price for the X4; typically seen ~$269-$349 across distributors (Global Test Supply, EngineerSupply, Amazon). Leica does not sell direct or publish a fixed consumer MSRP.

specs.measurement_modes: Distance, area, volume, indirect (Pythagoras), stakeout, min/max, addition/subtraction, smart room-scan sketch
specs.display_type: 2 in. color high-resolution display with digital pointfinder camera

products.provenance: Distributor pages (Global Test Supply, SITML, Kara Company, EngineerSupply) consistently confirm 500 ft (150 m) range, sub-1mm/1-16in-class accuracy, a 2 in. color display with digital pointfinder camera for bright-sunlight use, IP65 dust/water rating, 2m drop-tested rugged housing, built-in Bluetooth, and a 3-year Leica warranty. Leica does not sell direct or publish a single consumer list price; $299 used as a representative figure within the observed ~$269-$349 street range for this mid-tier X4 model.

products.name: Tacklife HD60 Classic 196 ft. Laser Distance Measure
products.priceNote: Representative current street price; historically seen $12.50-$25.06 on promotion (eBay/Amazon) and $13.79 clearance (Walmart). Tacklife does not publish a fixed consumer MSRP.

specs.measurement_modes: Distance, area, volume, addition/subtraction, Pythagorean, continuous, mute mode
specs.display_type: Backlit LCD with 2 built-in bubble levels

products.provenance: Walmart and eBay listings confirm a 196 ft range, ±1/16 in accuracy, dual bubble levels, backlit LCD, six selectable units, 30-group data memory, addition/subtraction, area/volume/Pythagorean modes, auto shut-off, and a mute/voice-indication toggle. No IP rating or laser safety class is stated on any fetched Tacklife listing, so both are left null rather than assumed from category norms. No Bluetooth capability is documented for this budget model. Price varies widely by promotion ($12.50-$25.06 historically observed); $29.99 used as a representative non-sale figure.

products.name: Mileseey S6 100m Laser Distance Meter
products.priceNote: No verified live US retail listing with a current price was found. A Sri Lankan distributor (NanoZone) lists the 100m S6 at Rs 12,500 (a regional price, not a confirmed US figure), so priceUsd is left null rather than guessed.

specs.battery_type: Rechargeable (built-in; specific chemistry not published by manufacturer)

products.provenance: Distributor spec sheet (NanoZone, reproducing Mileseey's manufacturer specifications) and eBay listing confirm the 100m/328 ft range variant, ±2 mm accuracy, IP54 dust/splash resistance, Class 1M (<1mW) laser, 0.5-second measurement speed, 30-group data storage, mute function, and single/Pythagorean/area/volume/addition-subtraction modes. No Bluetooth capability is documented on any fetched source for the S6 (unlike Mileseey's higher-tier camera models), so bluetooth is false. Battery chemistry is described only as 'rechargeable' without further detail on any fetched page. No current US retail price could be verified, so priceUsd is null.

products.name: Hilti PD-C Laser Meter with Camera
products.priceNote: PD-C has been discontinued/delisted from hilti.com (US) and superseded in the US lineup by the Hilti PD-I; no current US MSRP is published. Used/secondary-market units appear periodically on eBay.

specs.measurement_modes: Distance, area, indirect measurement, Measure-from-Photo, continuous
specs.display_type: Color touchscreen with built-in target camera

products.provenance: CORRECTED SOURCING FROM SEED: the PD-C is a genuine Hilti model (item no. 2102497) but is no longer listed on hilti.com (US), which currently shows only the PD-S, PD-I, and PD-E as active laser meters — the PD-I is Hilti's current Bluetooth-enabled successor in this tier. Specs were instead sourced from Hilti's still-live Kuwait regional product page, which lists this exact PD-C model: up to 200 m (656 ft) range, 1.0 mm accuracy, IP54 (EN 60529), Class 2 laser (<1mW, 635nm), Bluetooth + USB interfaces, 4 GB built-in memory, a built-in target camera, and up to 10h battery runtime on its Li-ion pack. Used units are still traded on eBay confirming the model exists and was sold in the US market historically; no current US MSRP is published anywhere, so priceUsd is null.

products.name: Stanley TLM99S Bluetooth-Enabled Laser Distance Measurer (STHT77343)
products.priceNote: 2015 launch MSRP (Stanley/Tool-Rank). Product has since been discontinued and removed from stanleytools.com; secondary-market (eBay) listings seen around $64.99.
products.provenance: Stanley's own product page (model STHT77343) confirms the TLM99S name, Bluetooth wireless connectivity for smartphone/tablet pairing, touch-pad LCD interface, 100 ft range, ±3/32 in (2mm) accuracy, and area/volume/distance/addition-subtraction functions; the page now shows the product as unavailable/discontinued. Tool-Rank's original April 2015 launch coverage confirms the $119.99 introductory price. IP rating, laser class, and battery type are not stated on any fetched source for this specific model and are left null rather than assumed from category norms; eBay resale listings ($64.99) confirm the model still circulates secondhand.

Replaced with Huepar's actual current Bluetooth laser distance meter, the S120G-BT, sourced directly from huepar.com: 395 ft (120 m) range, ±1/16 in accuracy, IP54 dust/water resistance, Class 2 green laser (490-560nm, <1mW), full Bluetooth app integration (no onboard display — readings appear only in the Huepar app), 2x rechargeable 1200mAh NiMH batteries with USB-C charging (also AA-compatible), a 1/4in tripod mount, 30-group data memory, and distance/angle/area/volume/4-mode-Pythagorean measurement functions.
